mapper.sql: l.logistics_id as logisticsId, l.tenant_id as tenantId, l.member_id as memberId, l.order_id as orderId, o.order_no as orderNo, coalesce(nullif(m.nickname, ''), nullif(m.legal_subject_name, ''), m.member_code) as merchantName, m.member_code as merchantCode, w.warehouse_name as warehouseName, l.direction as direction, l.carrier as carrier, l.tracking_no as trackingNo, l.source_type as sourceType, l.route_status as routeStatus, l.abnormal_flag as abnormalFlag, l.route_available as routeAvailable, l.route_provider as routeProvider, l.route_message as routeMessage, date_format(l.pickup_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as pickupTime, date_format(l.estimated_arrive_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as estimatedArriveTime, date_format(l.route_query_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as routeQueryTime, (select date_format(max(route.route_time), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') from ry_business.ry_rental_logistics_route route where route.logistics_id = l.logistics_id and route.is_delete = 0) as lastRouteTime, l.fee_amount as feeAmount, date_format(l.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as updateTime

l.logistics_id as logisticsId, l.tenant_id as tenantId, l.member_id as memberId, l.order_id as orderId, o.order_no as orderNo, null as merchantName, null as merchantCode, w.warehouse_name as warehouseName, l.direction as direction, l.carrier as carrier, l.tracking_no as trackingNo, l.source_type as sourceType, l.route_status as routeStatus, l.abnormal_flag as abnormalFlag, l.route_available as routeAvailable, l.route_provider as routeProvider, l.route_message as routeMessage, date_format(l.pickup_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as pickupTime, date_format(l.estimated_arrive_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as estimatedArriveTime, date_format(l.route_query_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as routeQueryTime, (select date_format(max(route.route_time), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') from ry_business.ry_rental_logistics_route route where route.logistics_id = l.logistics_id and route.is_delete = 0) as lastRouteTime, l.fee_amount as feeAmount, date_format(l.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as updateTime
mapper.select: select count(1) from ry_business.ry_rental_logistics_order l inner join ry_business.ry_rental_order o on o.tenant_id = l.tenant_id and o.member_id = l.member_id and o.order_id = l.order_id inner join ry_rental.ry_rental_member m on m.tenant_id = l.tenant_id and m.member_id = l.member_id where

select from ry_business.ry_rental_logistics_order l inner join ry_business.ry_rental_order o on o.tenant_id = l.tenant_id and o.member_id = l.member_id and o.order_id = l.order_id inner join ry_rental.ry_rental_member m on m.tenant_id = l.tenant_id and m.member_id = l.member_id left join ry_business.ry_rental_warehouse w on w.tenant_id = l.tenant_id and w.member_id = l.member_id and w.warehouse_id = coalesce(l.warehouse_id, case when l.direction = 2 then o.return_warehouse_id else o.warehouse_id end) and w.is_delete = 0 where order by l.abnormal_flag desc, l.route_query_time is null desc, l.update_time desc, l.logistics_id desc limit #{offset}, #{pageSize}

select from ry_business.ry_rental_logistics_order l inner join ry_business.ry_rental_order o on o.tenant_id = l.tenant_id and o.member_id = l.member_id and o.order_id = l.order_id inner join ry_rental.ry_rental_member m on m.tenant_id = l.tenant_id and m.member_id = l.member_id left join ry_business.ry_rental_warehouse w on w.tenant_id = l.tenant_id and w.member_id = l.member_id and w.warehouse_id = coalesce(l.warehouse_id, case when l.direction = 2 then o.return_warehouse_id else o.warehouse_id end) and w.is_delete = 0 where l.logistics_id = #{logisticsId} and l.is_delete = 0 and o.is_delete = 0 and m.is_delete = 0 limit 1

select from ry_business.ry_rental_logistics_order l inner join ry_business.ry_rental_order o on o.tenant_id = l.tenant_id and o.member_id = l.member_id and o.order_id = l.order_id left join ry_business.ry_rental_warehouse w on w.tenant_id = l.tenant_id and w.member_id = l.member_id and w.warehouse_id = coalesce(l.warehouse_id, case when l.direction = 2 then o.return_warehouse_id else o.warehouse_id end) and w.is_delete = 0 where l.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and l.member_id = #{memberId} and l.order_id = #{orderId} and l.is_delete = 0 and o.is_delete = 0 order by l.direction, l.create_time desc, l.logistics_id desc

select r.route_status as routeStatus, r.route_desc as routeDesc, date_format(r.route_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as routeTime, coalesce(nullif(r.city, ''), r.province) as location from ry_business.ry_rental_logistics_route r inner join ry_business.ry_rental_logistics_order l on l.logistics_id = r.logistics_id and l.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and l.member_id = #{memberId} and l.is_delete = 0 where r.logistics_id = #{logisticsId} and r.is_delete = 0 order by r.route_time desc, r.route_id desc

select c.provider as provider, c.carrier as carrier, c.tracking_no_masked as trackingNoMasked, c.available as available, c.provider_status as providerStatus, c.route_status as routeStatus, c.response_message as responseMessage, c.duration_ms as durationMs, c.error_type as errorType, date_format(c.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as createTime from ry_business.ry_rental_logistics_call_log c where c.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and c.member_id = #{memberId} and c.logistics_id = #{logisticsId} and c.is_delete = 0 order by c.create_time desc, c.call_log_id desc limit 50
